messages:
devon-peopleops: Follow-up from today's all-hands re: hybrid/remote travel. Putting answers in one place. Tagging @anna-peopleops and @mike-cto for policy/roadmap bits.
anna-peopleops: Quick links I'll attach: workspace desk-holds, expense policy, offsite checklist. Will post the short checklist here soon.
sam-eng: Question: if I'm remote-first and coming into hub for a 3-day offsite, can I reserve a desk for the whole week, including buffer days?
anna-peopleops: Short: we allow a 48-hour post-travel grace and 24-hour pre-travel buffer by default. For longer buffer requests, ask your manager and use the "temporary extended hold" flow — approvals evaluated case-by-case.
travel-bot: FYI: new expense-policy v2 is live: https://docs/redwood/finance/expense-policy-v2
mike-cto: For roadmap: travel-heavy teams — if your cadence causes consistent desk pressure, please file a capacity request so we can consider temporary desk expansion for that hub.
sam-eng: Reimbursement timing if I pay for lodging out of pocket?
anna-peopleops: Finance target is 7 business days after complete submission. Use PDF receipts when possible. If you don't see it by 10 business days, escalate to finance@redwood.com and cc people-ops.
devon-peopleops: Desk holds: use the workspace app, choose "offsite" or "post-travel grace". Offsite holds open 10 days before event; one hold per person per event.
sam-eng: Guests at offsites? Bringing spouse for weekend days of an offsite — allowed?
anna-peopleops: Guests permitted for social/offsite parts with manager sign-off and inclusion on RSVP. For working days in hubs, guests need manager approval + 72h badge request.
mike-cto: Note on tickets/fares: no company blackout. If the trip is mission-critical we recommend flexible fares. Sales/Customer teams may have separate approvals.
devon-peopleops: Action: we're creating a 1-page FAQ + checklist and a simple template for offsite owners. Expect that EOD. Drop edge cases here (visas, HSA reimbursements, long-term remote needing desks).
travel-bot: Tip: Upload receipts as PDFs when possible and include project tag format: offsite-<hub>-<year>.
sam-eng: Thanks — one more: transit stipend for late hub events?
anna-peopleops: Some hubs have a commute stipend for offsite days up to $15/day. Check HR portal stipend tab for your hub.
devon-peopleops: Great thread. If anything urgent DM me. I'll post the FAQ + checklist when ready. :thumbsup:
